subject: pyproject.toml declares typer>=0.27.2 and pydantic>=2.1 and version 1.4.1
source:
uv run python -c 'from pathlib import Path
text = Path("pyproject.toml").read_text()
assert "version = \"1.4.1\"" in text
assert "typer>=0.27.2" in text
assert "pydantic>=2.1" in text
assert "cryptography>=42" in text
assert "tomli-w>=1.0" in text
print("floors and version 1.4.1 ok")'
